first_launch.label: Getting started
first_launch.title: You need two versions of the game to compare
first_launch.intro: Capture the game installed on this computer. If the game has already updated and you missed the version before, import a baseline pack from the release page.
first_launch.capture.title: Capture your game
first_launch.capture.text: Reads the game folder on this computer. Nothing in the game folder is changed.
first_launch.import.title: Import a version
first_launch.import.text: A baseline pack from the release page, or a version someone exported for you.
first_launch.preview_warning: Getting a preview build? Capture the live version before you switch Steam to it.
webview2.missing.title: Patch Scout needs WebView2
webview2.missing.text:
Patch Scout shows its window with the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. It comes with Windows 11 and most Windows 10 PCs, but it isn't working on this one.

Open Microsoft's download page in your browser?
